title: Flux balance and knockouts
line: Which reactions a cell can lose and still grow.
description: Flux balance analysis of a small metabolic network, then single-reaction knockouts: which reactions the cell can lose and still grow, and how much growth it keeps. Reactions: 1 glucose uptake, 2 oxygen uptake, 3 glycolysis, 4 respiration, 5 fermentation, 6 biomass. Metabolites: glucose, oxygen, pyruvate, ATP.
thumbnailAlt: Bar chart of growth kept after each single-reaction knockout, rendered by RunMat
